items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 29.09.2026, sent by an authority by ordinary post: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 03.10.2026 (this day does not shift even though it is a public holiday, Tag der Deutschen Einheit, for this kind of deemed-delivery rule). The one-month Widerspruch period of § 70 Abs. 1 VwGO starts counting the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on Tue 03.11.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is a normal working day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).

items.title: Start of the 6-month Fahrtenbuch obligation
items.quote: Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The order states the six-month duty to keep a logbook (Fahrtenbuch) begins only once the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), i.e. either once the one-month Widerspruch period (ending 03.11.2026) has passed unused, or, if a Widerspruch is filed, once that procedure (and any subsequent Klage) is concluded. Because it is unknown today whether a Widerspruch will be filed, the exact start date of the six-month period cannot be fixed; the earliest possible start would be 04.11.2026 if no Widerspruch is lodged.

warnings: The exact start (and therefore end) of the six-month Fahrtenbuch duty cannot be computed now: it depends on whether a Widerspruch is filed and, if so, on when that procedure concludes.

No payment or fee is demanded in this letter; the printed IBAN belongs to the Kreis's account details footer and is not tied to any amount owed here, so it should not be used to send money in response to this letter.
